## When using the balance method (i.e. operating in the same way on both sides of an equation to maintain equality), it will be useful to explore what constitutes the most efficient solution with students. For example, in the equation 5 _x_ − 14 = 6, it is important for students to understand that any operation applied to both sides of the equation will result in equality being maintained and to reason why some operations lead to a solution more quickly than others.
